title: Information has a physical and an experiential aspect

statements.text: The theory incorporates Chalmers' double-aspect principle: information has a physical aspect and a phenomenal aspect. Information in a single molecule encodes nothing beyond itself, while field information is unified and can encode the outside world, so it is a suitable substrate for experience.

sources.quote: the cemi theory incorporates Chalmers’ (Chalmers 1995) ‘double-aspect’ principle that information has both a physical, and a phenomenal or experiential aspect
